mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (oprt_std_id) oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym,oprt_std_nm,num_val,txt_val,unit_nm,use_plc_desc FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND oprt_std_id IN ('SIG_DELAY_WARN','SIG_DELAY_RISK','SIG_COST_WARN','SIG_COST_RISK','SIG_STALE_DAYS','BUDGET_RATE', 'DISPATCH_MAX_MONTHS','DISPATCH_ALERT_DAYS','PLAN_GAP_TOLERANCE', 'RENEGO_COST_RATIO','TARGET_MARGIN_RATE','RENEGO_RAISE_RATE') ORDER BY oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym DESC

SELECT p.prj_id,p.prj_no,p.prj_nm,c.ptnr_nm AS "custName",p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.bsn_part_id, coalesce(d.dev_nm,'PM 미지정') AS "pmName",p.cur_cntrct_amt,p.prfm_bgn_dt,p.trgt_cst_amt, m.wrt_dt AS last_memo_dt,m.actl_prgs_rt, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd IN ('OPEN','DOING')) AS open_issue_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd IN ('OPEN','DOING') AND i.svrt_cd='HIGH') AS high_open_issue_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd!='CLOSED' AND i.ddln_dt < #{today}) AS overdue_issue_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd!='CLOSED' AND i.ddln_dt < #{today} AND i.svrt_cd='HIGH') AS high_overdue_count FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=p.pm_dev_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT wrt_dt,actl_prgs_rt FROM prj.wkly_memo w WHERE w.prj_id=p.prj_id ORDER BY wrt_dt DESC,memo_id DESC LIMIT 1) m ON true WHERE p.use_yn='Y' AND (p.prj_stts_cd='RUN' OR (p.prj_stts_cd='PLAN' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=p.prj_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today}))) ORDER BY p.prj_id
SELECT phs_id,prj_id,phs_seq,phs_nm,wght_rt,plan_bgn_dt,plan_end_dt,cmpl_dt,NULL::text AS status FROM prj.phs WHERE prj_id=#{id} ORDER BY phs_seq,phs_id
SELECT p.prj_id FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT f.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls f WHERE f.cls_ym=#{month}

WITH people AS ( SELECT s.dev_id FROM cst.mth_cst s WHERE s.cst_ym=#{month} UNION SELECT a.dev_id FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id WHERE m.work_ym=#{month} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' UNION SELECT e.dev_id FROM cst.drct_expns e WHERE e.expns_ym=#{month} AND e.dev_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT d.dev_id,coalesce(s.emp_se_cd,d.emp_se_cd) AS emp_se_cd, coalesce(s.duty_se_cd,d.duty_se_cd) AS duty_se_cd,s.indv_lbr_cst_amt FROM people x JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=x.dev_id LEFT JOIN cst.mth_cst s ON s.dev_id=d.dev_id AND s.cst_ym=#{month} ORDER BY d.dev_id

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,a.prj_id,m.mm_qty,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.prj_stts_cd, a.asgn_se_cd,u.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <= (#{month} || '-01')::date + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day' ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) u ON true WHERE m.work_ym=#{month} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' ORDER BY a.asgn_id
SELECT e.expns_id,e.dev_id,e.prj_id,e.expns_amt,p.cntrct_ty_cd FROM cst.drct_expns e LEFT JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=e.prj_id WHERE e.expns_ym=#{month} ORDER BY e.expns_id

WITH ranked AS ( SELECT l.prj_id,l.dev_id,m.aloc_amt, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY l.prj_id ORDER BY CASE l.aloc_stg_cd WHEN 'ACTUAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'FINAL' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) AS priority FROM prj.tk_aloc_line l JOIN prj.tk_aloc_mth m ON m.aloc_line_id=l.aloc_line_id WHERE m.aloc_ym=#{month} AND l.line_ty_cd='PERSON' AND l.dev_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT r.prj_id,r.dev_id,sum(r.aloc_amt)::bigint AS sls_amt FROM ranked r WHERE r.priority=1 AND r.aloc_amt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.prj_id,r.dev_id

SELECT s.dev_id,s.prj_id,s.asgn_id,s.aloc_ty_cd,s.mm_qty,s.tot_mm_qty,s.aloc_rt, s.lbr_cst_amt,s.drct_expns_amt,s.sls_amt,s.bill_untprc_amt, s.mm_ovr_yn='Y' AS mm_ovr,s.free_sprt_yn='Y' AS free_sprt,s.pre_cntrct_yn='Y' AS pre_cntrct FROM cst.cst_aloc s WHERE s.cst_ym=#{month} ORDER BY s.cst_aloc_id
